title: Hermite functions in the $L^2$ space
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a multi-index $\alpha:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb N$, define the corresponding element of the Gaussian $L^2$ space as the $L^2$ equivalence class of the Hermite function indexed by $\alpha$.
